```bash
curl -fsSL https://worklittle.com/install | bash
```

Same script: `https://docs.worklittle.com/install`. Verifies the CLI checksum from `manifest.json` before install. Default path is `~/.local/bin/worklittle` (override with `WORKLITTLE_INSTALL_PREFIX`).

**From the monorepo**

```bash
cd packages/sdk-js && npm install && npm run build
node dist/cli.js help
# or: npm link
```

Published packages:

```bash
npm install worklittle
pip install worklittle
```

The TypeScript package is also on npm as `@worklittle/sdk` (same code). The CLI binary is `worklittle` (`npm install -g worklittle`). Homebrew remains the recommended CLI install.

## Authentication

Bearer token. Create a key in the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business) under [API keys](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys).

```http
Authorization: Bearer sk-wl-api01-...
```

For the SDK and CLI, set `WORKLITTLE_API_KEY`. Prefer the env var over `--api-key` so the key does not appear in process lists. Do not point `--base-url` at hosts you do not trust. Public board GETs and public survey submit do not require a key.

## Usage

```text
worklittle <group> <action> [args] [--flag value] [--body '{}'] [--pretty|--json] [--api-key KEY]
```

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | Indented JSON on stdout |
| `--json` | Compact JSON (default) |
| `--api-key` | Override `WORKLITTLE_API_KEY` |
| `--base-url` | Override `https://api.worklittle.com` |
| `--body` | JSON body for POST/PATCH |
| `--q` `--title` `--limit` `--cursor` `--id` `--company` | Query params / positional fallbacks (same names as `GET /jobs`) |

`--company` accepts bare slugs (include OR) or leading-dash slugs to exclude, e.g. `--company=-lucid-motors,-tesla`. Title negatives stay in `--q` / `--title` (`-Senior`). Other `GET /jobs` flags pass through by name (`--workplace_type`, `--posted_within_days`, `--near_lat`, …). Full filter reference: [Search jobs](/jobs/api/search-jobs).

Also: `jobs map`, `jobs salary-average`, `companies search`, `stats get` (JS and Python CLIs).

Exit **0** on success, **2** on 401/403, **1** on other failures. Errors are JSON on stderr.

## Example

```bash
worklittle jobs search --q="software engineer" --limit 1 --pretty
worklittle jobs search --title="software engineer, -senior" --company="-lucid-motors,-tesla" --limit 5 --pretty
```

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "job_id": "…",
      "title": "Software Engineer",
      "company_name": "Example Co",
      "location": "San Francisco, CA"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "limit": 1,
    "next_cursor": "…"
  }
}
```

Then:

```bash
worklittle jobs get JOB_ID --pretty
```

## Board > apply

```bash
worklittle boards get YOUR_ORG_SLUG --include facets --pretty
worklittle boards job YOUR_ORG_SLUG JOB_SLUG_OR_ID --pretty
worklittle boards apply YOUR_ORG_SLUG JOB_SLUG_OR_ID --body '{
  "name": "Alex Rivera",
  "email": "alex@example.com",
  "answers": {}
}'
```

See [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs).

## Candidates

```bash
worklittle candidates list --limit 10 --pretty
worklittle candidates get CANDIDATE_ID --pretty
```

See [Manage candidates](/jobs/api/manage-candidates).

## Commands

| Command | Args / flags | HTTP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jobs search` | `--q` `--title` `--company` (+ any `GET /jobs` flag) | `GET /jobs` |
| `jobs get` | `JOB_ID` | `GET /jobs/:id` |
| `jobs map` | query flags | `GET /jobs/map` |
| `jobs salary-average` | query flags | `GET /jobs/salary-average` |
| `companies search` | query flags | `GET /companies` |
| `stats get` | query flags | `GET /stats` |
| `boards get` | `COMPANY` [`--include facets`] | `GET /job-boards/:company/board` |
| `boards jobs` | `COMPANY` | `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs` |
| `boards job` | `COMPANY` `ID_OR_SLUG` | `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id` |
| `boards facets` | `COMPANY` | `GET /job-boards/:company/facets` |
| `boards apply` | `COMPANY` `ID_OR_SLUG` `--body` | `POST …/jobs/:id/apply` |
| `apply submit` | `JOB_ID` `--body` | `POST /jobs/:id/apply` |
| `apply-with-ai *` | id / `--body` | `/v1/apply-with-ai` |
| `applied list` / `counts` / `track` / `update` | id / `--body` | `/applied-jobs` |
| `candidates list` / `get` / `update` / `import` / `stages` | id / `--body` | `/candidates`, `/pipeline-stages` |
| `employees list` / `get` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | id / `--body` | `/employees` |
| `listings *` | id / `--body` | `/job-listings` |
| `employer-jobs *` | id / `--body` | `/jobs/post` |
| `org list` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | `--body` | `/company-organizations` |
| `surveys list` / `get` / `create` / `update` / `responses` | id / `--body` | `/platform/surveys` |
| `documents list` / `create` / `templates` / `mine` | `--body` | `/platform/documents` |
| `attendance list` / `me` / `get` / `create` / `update` | id / `--body` | `/attendance` |
| `webhooks list` / `create` / `get` / `update` / `delete` / `test` / `rotate-secret` / `deliveries` | id / `--body` | `/webhooks` |
| `email list` / `create` / `update` / `delete` / `preview` / `send` | `--body` | `/email-messages`, `/email/send` |
| `email sends` / `send-get` / `send-events` | id / query flags | `GET /email/sends` |
| `offers list` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | `--body` | `/offers` |
| `usage list` | `--source` (`all` / `public_api` / `platform_ai` / `org_activity`) `--since` `--cursor` `--limit` | `GET /usage` (rows include `where_label` / `where_href` — Chat, Voice, jobs, Private; same Destination as [Usage](https://worklittle.com/business/usage)) |
| `billing balance` / `invoices` / `usage` | | `/billing/*` |
| `limits get` / `budget` / `budget-set` | `--body` | `/limits` |

| `health` | | `GET /health` |

Other `--flag value` pairs are forwarded as query parameters (except `--body`). The JS Homebrew CLI is canonical; the Python CLI is a smaller subset (`usage`, `billing`, `email sends` included).

# Search jobs

Search Worklittle's open-role index, paginate results, and fetch enriched job details for agents and job boards.

## Overview

Worklittle maintains a market-wide index of millions of open roles, enriched with location, salary, and company data, alongside jobs employers publish on Worklittle. `GET /jobs` returns discovery rows; `GET /jobs/:id` returns the full posting. MCP mirrors the same flows with `search_jobs` and `get_job_details`.

## When to use

If you are building:

* A **job board or search UI**
  * List matching roles with `GET /jobs` or MCP `search_jobs`
  * Open detail pages with `GET /jobs/:id` or `get_job_details`
* A **career copilot or matching agent**
  * Rank listings, then pull keywords with `get_job_keywords` before resume tailoring
* A **market analytics dashboard**
  * Use `GET /stats` or `get_market_overview` for aggregate counts (not row-level search)

## Basic usage

> **Tip:** Job search is included in the monthly free Jobs API quota (not billed per job returned). Default `limit` is 20, max **50**. Always follow list rows with a detail fetch for full descriptions.

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs?q=product+designer&workplace_type=remote&limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs/JOB_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

MCP equivalent: `search_jobs` then `get_job_details` with the `job_id` from results.

## Search jobs reference

> Self-contained reference for coding agents using Worklittle job search.

### Overview

| Route | Method | Scope | Billing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/jobs` | GET | `jobs:read` | Free within monthly quota - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing) |
| `/jobs/:id` | GET | `jobs:read` | Free within monthly quota |
| `/stats` | GET | `jobs:read` | Free |
| `/jobs/map` | GET | `jobs:read` | Free within monthly company/map quota - see [Search companies](/jobs/api/search-companies) |
| `/jobs/salary-average` | GET | `jobs:read` | **$0.05** per request |

MCP: `search_jobs`, `get_job_details`, `get_job_keywords`, `get_market_overview`.

## List response shape

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "…",
      "title": "Senior Product Designer",
      "company": { "name": "Example Co" },
      "apply_url": "https://…",
      "apply_with_ai_eligible": true,
      "closed_at": null
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "next_cursor": "…" }
}
```

List rows are **snippets**. They do not include the full `job_description`. Use `meta.next_cursor` as `cursor` on the next request.

List rows include `closed_at` (always null on this endpoint). Search never returns closed jobs and has no `closes_at` filter. Read `closes_at` on `GET /jobs/:id` / `get_job_details` when you need the ATS deadline. See [Closed jobs and eligibility](/use-cases/closed-jobs-and-eligibility).

**Apply with AI:** use `apply_with_ai_eligible` (boolean) to decide whether `POST /v1/apply-with-ai` can run for that job. Do not infer from `source_name` or `apply_url`. See [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs).

`GET /jobs/:id` `description_text` is plain text, never HTML. ATS headings and `<b>` become `**bold**`, lists become `- ` bullets (nested lists indent with two spaces), and safe `<a href>` links become `[label](url)`. Bold is display only. Do not treat bold spans as Create Resume keywords. Use `keywords` / `get_job_keywords` for that.

## Salary average

Aggregate annual compensation for jobs matching a search query. Uses the same filters and negative title tokens as `GET /jobs` (`-Senior` in `q` or `title`).

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs/salary-average?title=Product+Manager,+-Senior,+-Principal,+-Lead,+-Staff,+-Director,+-Group&workplace_type=remote&country=US" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

| Parameter | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `q` or `title` | **Required.** Role query; comma-separated OR phrases; `-token` exclusions (`-Senior` also matches Sr./Sr titles) |
| `currency` | ISO 4217 code for salary rows included in the average (default `USD`) |
| `location`, `company`, `workplace_type`, etc. | Same filters as [Common filters](#common-filters) |

Response `data` includes `matching_jobs`, `jobs_with_salary`, `jobs_in_average`, `average_salary`, `salary_min`, and `salary_max` (annual amounts in `currency`). Only jobs with annualized pay between **$30k and $1M** are included in the average (mis-parsed or extreme outliers are excluded). Hourly and monthly postings are annualized before averaging. **$0.05** per request - see [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).

## Common filters

| Parameter | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `q` | Title or company text match |
| `title` | Title-only match (comma-separated). Prefix `-` to exclude title substrings - `-Senior` also excludes **Sr.** / **Sr** titles; same for `-Principal`, `-Lead`, `-Staff`, `-Director`, `-Executive`, `-VP`, `-Head`, `-Chief`, `-Group` |
| `location`, `location_or` | Location filters |
| `company` | Company slug(s). Bare = include OR (`stripe` or `meta,google`). Prefix `-` to exclude (`-lucid-motors,-tesla`). Same leading-dash rule as title negatives, but employers stay in `company` |
| `employment_type`, `workplace_type`, `seniority_level` | Structured filters. `employment_type` and `seniority_level` accept comma-separated values (OR / SQL `IN`), e.g. `full_time,part_time` or `internship,entry,new_grad` |
| `posted_within_days` | Optional rolling lookback in days. `0` = no cutoff. Omit = no cutoff on REST (including `company=`). Chat/MCP tools default to **14** when the model omits it. |
| `since` | Unix timestamp lower bound (wins over `posted_within_days` when both set) |
| `limit`, `cursor` | Pagination (max 50) |

## Agent REST tools

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/v1/agent/tools` | List REST agent tools and JSON schemas |
| POST | `/v1/agent/tool` | Run `search_jobs`, `get_job_details`, `create_resume`, or `create_cover_letter` (legacy wrapper) |

Requires `agent:tools` scope. Prefer `POST /v1/resumes` and `POST /v1/cover-letters` for documents. Full ATS is on [MCP](/jobs/mcp).

## Common mistakes

| Wrong | Correct |
| --- | --- |
| Using list `job_summary` as the full JD | Call `GET /jobs/:id` or `get_job_details` |
| Ignoring pagination | Pass `cursor` until `meta.next_cursor` is null |
| Expecting hosted apply on every `job_id` | Some indexed roles use an employer `apply_url`; hosted apply is [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs) |

## Patterns and gotchas

* **MCP/chat recency** - `posted_within_days`: today > 1, this week > 7, vague new/recent > 14; omit defaults to 14 in tools; `0` = any age. Never put those words in `query`.
* **Company lists** - `GET /jobs?company=` returns all open roles when recency is omitted. Pass `posted_within_days` or `since` only when you want a lookback window.
* **First detail fetch may enrich** - AI enrichment runs once; later reads are cached.
* **Keywords for tailoring** - `get_job_keywords` strips prose; better input for `create_resume` / `create_cover_letter`.
* **Pair with apply** - After `get_job_details`, use `submit_job_application` for Worklittle-hosted roles.

# Search companies

Find employers by name or slug, map them in the index, scope job search by company, and render public Worklittle-hosted job boards.

## Overview

Company discovery starts with `GET /companies?q=` (name/slug search over employers with open jobs), then `GET /jobs/map`, `company=` on `GET /jobs`, and **employer-hosted boards** (`GET /job-boards/:company/...`) that list only jobs published on Worklittle.

## When to use

If you are building:

* A **typeahead or global search** for employers
  * `GET /companies?q=google&limit=5` returns ranked companies with logos for typeahead
* A **hiring map or geo dashboard**
  * `GET /jobs/map` returns company HQ, coordinates, logo, and open job count per employer
* A **single-employer career site**
  * Filter `GET /jobs?company=slug` for all indexed roles at that employer (comma-separated OR; prefix `-` to exclude, e.g. `-lucid-motors`), or `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs` for Worklittle-hosted postings only. The consumer company page at worklittle.com/company/:slug mixes both lists. These API routes stay separate.
* A **white-label apply experience**
  * Board routes include branding, full descriptions, and public apply - no API key

## Basic usage

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/companies?q=glossier&limit=5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs/map?limit=50" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs?company=stripe&limit=20" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs"
```

> **Tip:** `GET /companies` and `GET /jobs/map` are metered per company row - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing). Public job boards are free (IP rate limits).

## Search companies reference

> Self-contained reference for company-scoped job discovery.

### Overview

| Route | Auth | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /companies?q=` | `jobs:read` | Ranked company name/slug search (employers with ≥1 job). MCP: `search_companies` |
| `GET /jobs/map` | `jobs:read` | Companies with coordinates + job counts |
| `GET /jobs?company=` | `jobs:read` | Jobs by employer slug(s): bare = include OR; leading `-` = exclude |
| `GET /job-boards/:company/*` | None | Hosted board (Worklittle-posted jobs only) |

### `GET /companies` params

| Param | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `q` | Required, 2–80 chars. Trailing words like "jobs" / "careers" are stripped. |
| `limit` | Default 5, max 20 |

Ranking: exact slug > exact name > slug/name prefix > name contains (multi-word). Payload is identity + logo/enrichment fields (no `job_count` / HQ). Responses are edge-cached (~30 days).

MCP / SDK / CLI: pass the same `company` string on job search (e.g. `stripe` or `-lucid-motors,-tesla`). For employer typeahead use MCP `search_companies` (same as REST `GET /companies?q=`) - agents should resolve real slugs/ids from the index, not invent them.

## Include and exclude employers on job search

`company` on `GET /jobs` (and on SDK `jobs.search` / CLI `--company` / MCP `search_jobs`) takes exact slugs:

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `stripe` | Only Stripe |
| `meta,google,apple` | Any of those employers (OR) |
| `-lucid-motors` | All employers except Lucid |
| `meta,google,-amazon` | Meta or Google, never Amazon |

Only a **leading** `-` excludes. Mid-slug hyphens are part of the brand (`lucid-motors`). Title exclusions (`-Senior`) stay in `title` / `q`, not in `company`. See [Search jobs](/jobs/api/search-jobs).

## Public job boards

| Endpoint | Auth | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /job-boards/:company` | None | Board branding, profile, and `features` toggles |
| `GET /job-boards/:company/board` | None | Board bundle (profile + listings + `features`) |
| `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs` | None | List employer-posted jobs (full descriptions) |
| `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id` | None | Single posted job for apply UI (`application_fields` + `features`) |
| `POST /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/apply` | None | Public apply (20/min per IP) |
| `POST /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/parse-resume` | None | Resume parse for apply form (respects `features.resume_autofill`) |
| `GET /v1/job-boards/...` | None | Versioned aliases |
| `GET /companies/:company/jobs` | None | Company-oriented jobs alias |

This index lists only jobs the employer published on Worklittle, not every role in the global `GET /jobs` index.

## Map filters

| Parameter | Role |
| --- | --- |
| Bounding box (`north`, `south`, `east`, `west`) | Geo filter |
| `center_lat`, `center_lng`, `radius_km` | Radius search |
| `limit` | Cap rows returned |

## Common mistakes

| Wrong | Correct |
| --- | --- |
| Expecting every indexed job on `/job-boards/...` | Boards are employer-published only; use `GET /jobs` for the full market index |
| Searching companies with `GET /jobs?title=Google` | Use `GET /companies?q=Google` for employer hits, or `GET /jobs?company=google` for that employer's roles |
| Omitting `q` on `GET /companies` | `q` is required (min 2 characters) |

# Apply for jobs

Submit candidate applications to Worklittle-hosted jobs and track which roles you applied to. Use your API key for programmatic apply flows, list applied jobs via REST or MCP, or public job-board routes for hosted forms without a key.

## Overview

Worklittle **apply** routes accept applications only for jobs the employer published on Worklittle (hosted boards and `POST /jobs/:id/apply`). Many roles in the global `GET /jobs` index include an employer `apply_url` for off-platform apply instead.

Read [Search jobs](/jobs/api/search-jobs) to find roles, then confirm the job is Worklittle-hosted before calling apply.

## When to use

If you are building:

* A **job board or career site** that lists Worklittle-hosted roles
  * Render listings with `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs`
  * Submit applications with `POST /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/apply` (no API key)
  * Prefill apply forms with `POST …/parse-resume` when the job accepts resume upload
* A **recruiting agent or application copilot**
  * Collect candidate details in your product
  * Submit on their behalf with `POST /jobs/:id/apply` or MCP `submit_job_application` (`jobs:apply`)
  * Pair with `get_job_details` to read `application_fields` before submit
* An **ATS integration or webhook consumer**
  * Successful applies create employer ATS candidates when the job has an organization
  * Listen for `candidate.application_submitted` - [Webhooks](/jobs/webhooks/overview)
* A **resume-first apply UX**
  * Call `parse-resume` on the public board to autofill name, email, and custom answers
  * Attach `resume_file` on apply; background AI extraction runs after submit

## Pick an endpoint

> **Tip:** Hosted board apply is free at the HTTP layer (IP rate limits only). API apply is **$0.01** per successful submit - see [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).

| Flow | Endpoint | Auth | Billing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Your backend submits for a user** | `POST /jobs/:id/apply` or MCP `submit_job_application` | Bearer `sk-wl-api01-...` with `jobs:apply` | $0.01 per application |
| **Apply with AI** | `POST /v1/apply-with-ai` or MCP `start_apply_with_ai` | Bearer key with `jobs:apply_with_ai` (or `jobs:apply`), or signed-in / OAuth | AI token usage at published rates. Typical successful session ~$0.01–$0.03. Excess starts `queued` (Waiting); credit / Instant gates spend |
| **Public apply form on a company board** | `POST /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/apply` | None (20 req/min per IP) | Free |
| **Resume autofill for board forms** | `POST /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/parse-resume` | None (20 req/min per IP) | Free |

## Apply with AI

Automate applications for jobs where `apply_with_ai_eligible` is `true` on `GET /jobs` or `GET /jobs/:id`. **More than 3 million** open jobs currently qualify, and that set grows as more employer forms can be filled and submitted. Check that field before starting a session - do not infer eligibility from `source_name` or `apply_url`.

**Billing.** Apply with AI bills **AI token usage** at published rates (form fill, on-session resume generation, essays, and related model turns). Spend lands on the key owner's Personal organization as **AI job apply** on [Usage](https://worklittle.com/business/usage). Successful sessions typically bill about **$0.01–$0.03**. See [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).

There is **no per-account concurrent cap**. Starts are gated by AI credit (free monthly, Instant, or PAYG). Worklittle holds **up to 200** global Browser Run slots at once and starts at most **3** new browsers per second. When slots, launch rate, or the daily browser budget is full, the session is `queued` (Waiting) until a slot frees. Instant's **$20/mo** AI credit (when active on that Personal org) covers on the order of **up to ~2,000** typical Apply with AI sessions per period before PAYG.

A successful start for a **personal** API key also mirrors the run into the key owner's worklittle.com Recents (same job chip and "Apply for this job for me" as clicking Apply). That chat is watch-only — stop, continue, and approve stay on this API / MCP. It does not appear in the floating Applying with AI status pill (that pill is only for applies started in the consumer UI). Start still succeeds if the chat write fails. Company-org keys do not create a consumer chat. Returns `chat_id`, `chat_url` (includes `?account=` so multi-account browsers switch to the right user; `null` for company keys), and `user_id`, plus the apply `session`.

The session opens a browser run of the employer apply form, fills it from the candidate resume, and **submits by default**. On worklittle.com that run appears as a **cloud browser in chat** so the person can always watch and take control anytime. The candidate does not need to answer questions or click Submit. API responses include `live_view_url` for the same live view.

**Always submit is on by default.** Pass `"auto_submit": false` only if the candidate should look first, then call `POST /v1/apply-with-ai/:id/approve-submit` / MCP `approve_apply_submit` when status is `awaiting_submit`.

**Idempotency.** Pass `Idempotency-Key` (8–200 chars, `A–Z a–z 0–9 . _ : -`) on `POST /v1/apply-with-ai`. Retries with the same key return the same session (`idempotent_replay: true`) for 24 hours.

**Session webhooks.** Optional `webhook_url` (HTTPS) on start receives `POST` JSON when status becomes `awaiting_submit`, `awaiting_input`, `paused`, `completed`, `failed`, `stopped`, or `cancelled`. Header `X-Worklittle-Apply-Event` is `apply.session.<status>`. Body includes `event`, `session_id`, `status`, and `session`. Delivery retries up to 3 times. You can still poll.

**Cloud workers.** Browser Runs are queued on Cloudflare (`curastem-apply`) so multi-minute applies do not depend on your HTTP connection staying open. Poll or webhooks — you do not need to hold a stream.

**Verification codes.** When the form needs email or SMS verification, Worklittle may use a temporary email alias or SMS number so codes can be read automatically. Your real contact info stays on the application when possible. Session responses include `proxy_contact_reasons` explaining why.

**Field telemetry.** `GET /v1/apply-with-ai/:id` returns `status`, `form_progress` (`required_filled` / `required_total` / `updated_at`), `field_fills` (what was written into each input), and `final_fields`. Only `status: "completed"` means the application was submitted. `awaiting_submit` means the form is ready (approve-submit / Always submit), not success yet. Other statuses include `queued`, `running`, `awaiting_input`, `paused`, `failed`, `cancelled`, and `stopped`.

```bash
# 1) Find an eligible job
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs?q=software+engineer&limit=5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  | jq '.data[] | select(.apply_with_ai_eligible == true) | {id, title, apply_with_ai_eligible}'

# 2) Start Apply with AI (always submit on by default)
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/apply-with-ai" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -d '{ "job_id": "JOB_ID", "webhook_url": "https://example.com/hooks/apply" }'
```

Then poll `GET /v1/apply-with-ai/SESSION_ID` (MCP `get_apply_session`) until `status` is terminal — treat only `completed` as submitted. If you started with `"auto_submit": false` and `status` is `awaiting_submit`, approve, then keep polling:

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/apply-with-ai/SESSION_ID/approve-submit" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

MCP tools: `start_apply_with_ai`, `get_apply_session`, `approve_apply_submit`, `continue_apply`, `stop_apply`.

SDK:

```ts
await wl.apply.startWithAi({ job_id: "JOB_ID" });
```

```python
wl.apply.start_with_ai({"job_id": "JOB_ID"})
```

CLI: `worklittle apply-with-ai start --body '{"job_id":"JOB_ID"}'`.

## Basic usage

Load the job schema first. For boards, `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id` returns `application_fields` when you need the full form definition.

**API key apply** (programmatic hosted jobs):

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs/JOB_ID/apply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Alex Rivera",
    "email": "alex@example.com",
    "phone": "+14155550100",
    "linkedin_url": "https://linkedin.com/in/alexrivera",
    "answers": {
      "years_experience": "8"
    }
  }'
```

**MCP** (same as API key apply):

```json
{
  "name": "submit_job_application",
  "arguments": {
    "job_id": "JOB_ID",
    "name": "Alex Rivera",
    "email": "alex@example.com",
    "phone": "+14155550100"
  }
}
```

**Public job board apply** (hosted form, no key):

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/JOB_ID/apply" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Alex Rivera",
    "email": "alex@example.com",
    "phone": "+14155550100",
    "similar_job_alerts": true
  }'
```

> **Note:** Public board apply requires `similar_job_alerts` as explicit `true` or `false` (Yes/No on the hosted form). API apply treats it as optional opt-in when set to `true`.

## Apply for jobs reference

> Self-contained reference for coding agents using Worklittle job applications.

### Overview

| Route | Method | Auth | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/jobs/:id/apply` | POST | `jobs:apply` | Submit application (MCP: `submit_job_application`) |
| `/applied-jobs` | GET | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | List tracked applies (MCP: `list_applied_jobs`) |
| `/applied-jobs/counts` | GET | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | Board total + per-stage counts (no job cards) |
| `/applied-jobs` | POST | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | Track a save or apply click (MCP: `track_applied_job`) |
| `/applied-jobs` | PATCH | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | Bulk move jobs to a pipeline stage |
| `/applied-jobs/:job_id` | PATCH | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | Update apply status (MCP: `update_applied_job_status`) |
| `/applied-jobs/:job_id` | DELETE | `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply` | Remove from pipeline (MCP: `delete_applied_job`) |
| `/account` | GET | `jobs:read` | API key owner email (MCP: `get_connected_account`) |
| `/job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/apply` | POST | None | Same payload rules; public CORS; IP rate limit |
| `/job-boards/:company/jobs/:id/parse-resume` | POST | None | Extract autofill map from resume file (board jobs with resume field only) |

`:id` is the job's `public_job_id` (also the `id` on `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id`). `:company` is the employer `company_slug`.

**Eligible jobs:** Only rows where the employer published on Worklittle. Index-only listings without a hosted apply path return **404** on these routes.

## Minimal working example

```bash
# 1) Read form schema (public board)
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/JOB_ID"

# 2) Submit (API key)
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs/JOB_ID/apply" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Alex Rivera","email":"alex@example.com","phone":"+14155550100"}'
```

## Request body

JSON body. Top-level keys map to built-in fields; custom employer questions use `answers[<field_id>]`.

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` or `full_name` | string | Required when the job's `name` builtin is required (default on employer forms) |
| `email` | string | Valid email; required when builtin `email` is required |
| `phone` | string | Required when builtin `phone` is required |
| `location_city`, `location_state`, `location_country` | string | Optional location hints |
| `linkedin_url`, `github_url`, `portfolio_url` | string | HTTPS URLs; invalid hosts are dropped |
| `resume_text` | string | Plain-text resume (max 100k chars) |
| `resume_file` | object | `{ "filename", "content_base64", "mime?" }` - max 10 MB decoded. Accepted: PDF, DOC/DOCX, RTF, TXT/MD, and images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC/HEIF) |
| `cover_letter` | string | Plain-text cover letter |
| `cover_letter_file` | object | Same shape as `resume_file` |
| `answers` | object | Custom field values keyed by field `id` from `application_fields` |
| `similar_job_alerts` | boolean | **Public board only:** must be `true` or `false`. API route: optional; `true` opts into similar-job emails |
| `metadata` | object | API apply only; stored on the application row (4k JSON cap) |

## Application fields schema

Employers configure forms in `application_fields` on the posted job. Built-in ids include `name`, `email`, `phone`, `resume_file`, `cover_letter`, `linkedin_url`, `github_url`, `website_url`, and `demographic_survey`.

Custom fields use `kind: "custom"` with types such as `short_text`, `long_text`, `dropdown`, `file_upload`, and `yes_no`. Submit values under `answers`:

```json
{
  "name": "Alex Rivera",
  "email": "alex@example.com",
  "answers": {
    "custom_question_id": "Yes",
    "resume_file": {
      "filename": "resume.pdf",
      "content_base64": "JVBERi0xLjQK..."
    }
  }
}
```

Validation runs server-side against the job snapshot. Missing required builtins or custom answers return **400** with a specific message.

## Response shape

Successful submit returns **201** with an `application` object.

**API apply** (`POST /jobs/:id/apply`):

```json
{
  "application": {
    "id": "api_…",
    "job_id": "JOB_ID",
    "status": "submitted",
    "submitted_at": "2026-06-03T22:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "people_search_profile": {
    "status": "updated",
    "resume": "saved_to_profile",
    "ai_resume_extraction": "queued"
  },
  "ats": {
    "status": "queued"
  },
  "billing": { }
}
```

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `application.id` | Stable application id (`api_…` or `board_…`) |
| `people_search_profile` | Updates candidate profile when email is present; resume AI runs async |
| `ats.status` | `queued` when the job belongs to an organization; otherwise `skipped_no_organization` |
| `billing` | Metered charge details for API apply |

**Public board apply** returns `application` only (no billing block).

## Parse resume (public boards)

When the job's `application_fields` include `resume_file`:

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/JOB_ID/parse-resume" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "resume_file": {
      "filename": "resume.pdf",
      "content_base64": "JVBERi0xLjQK..."
    }
  }'
```

Returns `{ "autofill": { … }, "status": "ok" }` with suggested values for builtins and custom ids. Results are cached (~2h per resume hash + job). If the job has no resume field, returns **400**. If the organization disabled resume autofill (`features.resume_autofill: false`), returns **400** with code `resume_autofill_disabled` - resume upload on apply still works when the job has `resume_file`.

## Build a custom careers site

Use the public job-board routes (no API key, CORS `*`) to power your own careers UI with your design and form inputs.

OpenAPI: [docs.worklittle.com/openapi/openapi.yaml](https://docs.worklittle.com/openapi/openapi.yaml). Clients: [SDK](/jobs/libraries/sdk) / [CLI](/jobs/libraries/cli).

1. **List roles + branding** (filters + optional facets)

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/board?limit=25&include=facets&department=Engineering&workplace_type=remote"
```

Each job includes `slug` and `url_path` (`/job-boards/{org}/jobs/{slug}`) - map those to your `/careers/{slug}` routes. Query params: `q`, `department`, `workplace_type`, `employment_type`, `location`. Facets also at `GET /job-boards/:company/facets`.

Board GETs send weak `ETag` values. Send `If-None-Match` for **304**. Optional Bearer API key raises the GET limit (typically 600/min vs IP 120/min).

2. **Load one job for the apply page**

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/growth-engineer"
# Preview an unpublished draft (employer preview_key only):
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/growth-engineer?preview=PREVIEW_KEY"
```

`:id` accepts `public_job_id`, posted job id, or `slug`. Detail includes `application_fields`, `description_sections` + `description_sections_meta` (never an empty unusable body), and `features`.

3. **Optional resume autofill** - when `features.resume_autofill` is `true` and the form includes `resume_file`, call `POST …/parse-resume` and map `autofill` into your fields.

4. **Submit**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/acme/jobs/growth-engineer/apply" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "Alex Rivera",
    "email": "alex@example.com",
    "phone": "+14155550100",
    "resume_file": { "filename": "resume.pdf", "content_base64": "…" },
    "answers": { "years_experience": "3" },
    "similar_job_alerts": true
  }'
```

Stable error codes: `role_closed`, `duplicate_application`, `validation_error`, `resume_autofill_disabled`, `RATE_LIMITED`. Success returns `application.id`.

5. **SEO** - `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:idOrSlug/json-ld?canonical_url=https://example.com/careers/slug` returns Google `JobPosting` JSON-LD. Revalidate `/careers` and `/careers/{slug}` on `job.published` / `job.updated` / `job.closed` webhooks.

SDK helper (after building `packages/sdk-js` - see [SDK](/jobs/libraries/sdk)):

```ts
import { createWorklittle, jobCareersPath } from "worklittle";
const wl = createWorklittle();
const { jobs } = await wl.boards.get("acme", { include: "facets" }) as { jobs: Array<{ id: string; slug?: string; title: string }> };
const href = jobCareersPath(jobs[0]); // /careers/{slug}
```

Reference implementation: [worklittle.com/careers](https://worklittle.com/careers).

## SEO for custom domains

* Serve one HTML route per `job.slug` (or rewrite `/careers/{slug}` > your detail template).
* Inject JSON-LD from `GET …/json-ld` and set `canonical_url` to your absolute careers URL.
* Prefer webhook-driven revalidation over polling. Board list/detail GETs already support `ETag` / `304`.
* Keep sitemap URLs aligned with public slugs, not opaque UUIDs.

## Board feature toggles

Public board capabilities are API-only (not in the Work UI). They appear on `GET /job-boards/:company`, `GET …/board`, and `GET …/jobs/:id` as `features`. Set them with `PUT /v1/employer/organization` (session or API key).

| Feature | Default | When `false` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `resume_autofill` | `true` | `POST …/parse-resume` returns **400** `resume_autofill_disabled`. Resume upload on apply still allowed if the job has `resume_file`. |
| `similar_job_alerts` | `true` | Board apply does not require `similar_job_alerts`. |

Unset or omitted keys behave as **on**. Example body:

```json
{
  "board_features": {
    "resume_autofill": true,
    "similar_job_alerts": false
  }
}
```

Integrators should read `features` before building autofill UX or the similar-jobs question - do not hardcode.

## Track applied jobs

Worklittle keeps a per-account list of jobs you applied to or clicked **Apply** for - both on **worklittle.com** and through the **API/MCP** with your platform API key (`sk-wl-api01-…`). The key is linked to your Worklittle account, so `POST /jobs/:id/apply` and MCP `submit_job_application` automatically add a tracked row with **success** when the submit succeeds.

Each row includes **job id**, **title**, **company**, **method** (`apply`, `apply_with_ai`, or `api`), and **status**:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `saved` | Heart / saved on /jobs or the MCP Jobs app (before apply) |
| `in_progress` | User clicked Apply or started Apply with AI |
| `applied` | Successfully submitted (Apply with AI completed, API apply, or manually moved) |
| `interview` | User moved the job to Interview on their /saved board |
| `offer` | User moved the job to Offer |
| `rejected` | User marked Rejected |
| `withdrawn` | User marked Withdrawn |
| `skipped` | Skipped on the consumer /jobs swipe deck |

**REST** (Bearer API key with `jobs:read` or `jobs:apply`, or signed-in session on worklittle.com):

| Route | Method | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/applied-jobs` | GET | List tracked jobs (optional `?status=`, `?fields=lite\|full`). `lite` (default) is the pipeline row only — no catalog job join. Use `full` for live logos and salary. |
| `/applied-jobs/counts` | GET | Board `total` + `by_status` counts for every pipeline stage |
| `/applied-jobs` | POST | Record a save or off-platform apply (MCP: `track_applied_job`) |
| `/applied-jobs` | PATCH | Bulk move jobs to a stage (`job_ids`, `status`, optional `insert_index`) |
| `/applied-jobs/:job_id` | PATCH | Update one job's stage |
| `/applied-jobs/:job_id` | DELETE | Remove from the pipeline (MCP: `delete_applied_job`) |

```bash
# Board totals for column badges (no job cards)
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/applied-jobs/counts" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"

# List what this API key's account has applied to
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/applied-jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"

# Manually track an off-platform apply your agent drove
curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/applied-jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "job_id": "JOB_ID",
    "job_title": "Software Engineer",
    "company_name": "Acme Corp",
    "apply_url": "https://careers.example.com/jobs/123",
    "status": "in_progress"
  }'

# Move to Applied (or interview / offer / rejected / withdrawn / skipped)
curl -s -X PATCH "https://api.worklittle.com/applied-jobs/JOB_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "status": "applied" }'
```

**MCP tools** (same account linkage as REST):

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `list_applied_jobs` | Same as `GET /applied-jobs` |
| `track_applied_job` | Same as `POST /applied-jobs` (use `status: saved` for heart/save) |
| `update_applied_job_status` | Same as `PATCH /applied-jobs/:job_id` |
| `delete_applied_job` | Same as `DELETE /applied-jobs/:job_id` |

On **worklittle.com**, signed-in users can ask the AI mentor which jobs they applied to (internal `get_applied_jobs` tool). Signed-out users keep device-local history in the browser only.

Tracking is **free** - no metered charge for list or track endpoints.

## Common mistakes

| Wrong | Correct |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /jobs/:id/apply` on a job without hosted apply | Use `apply_url` from `GET /jobs/:id`, or list Worklittle-hosted jobs via `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs` |
| Missing `jobs:apply` on the API key | Create or rotate a key with `jobs:apply` - [API Keys](/jobs/get-started/api-keys) |
| Omit `similar_job_alerts` on public board apply when the feature is on | Send `true` or `false` explicitly, or check `features.similar_job_alerts` first |
| Calling parse-resume when autofill is off | Check `features.resume_autofill`; expect `resume_autofill_disabled` if disabled |
| Custom answers at top level instead of `answers` | Put custom field ids under `answers` unless they are builtins (`name`, `email`, etc.) |
| Assuming list rows include `application_fields` | Fetch job detail (`GET /job-boards/.../jobs/:id` or hosted job detail) before building the form |

## Patterns and gotchas

* **Read `application_fields` before submit.** Employers add screening questions, file uploads, and required custom fields. The hosted job detail endpoint is the source of truth.
* **Read `features` before autofill UX.** Resume autofill and similar-job alerts are org toggles (default on).
* **Email unlocks async work.** Without `email`, profile update, similar-job alerts, and ATS candidate creation are skipped or reduced.
* **Resume file format.** Use base64 (optional `data:application/pdf;base64,` prefix). Filename is required. Max decoded size 10 MB.
* **Webhooks fire after ATS upsert.** Subscribe to `candidate.application_submitted` on the employer organization to sync your CRM.
* **API apply is metered.** Each successful `POST /jobs/:id/apply` debits **$0.01** from API balance - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).
* **MCP `submit_job_application`** - Same body as REST; requires `job_id` plus applicant fields.
* **Pair with document tools.** Use `create_resume` / `create_cover_letter`, then attach via `resume_file` / `cover_letter_file` on apply.
* **Public boards** - No MCP for unauthenticated apply; use REST `POST /job-boards/.../apply` or direct candidates to `apply_url`.
* **Custom careers sites** - Follow [Build a custom careers site](#build-a-custom-careers-site) for the full list > detail > parse > apply loop.

Coding agent documentation index Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.worklittle.com/docs-agent-manifest.json Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further. # Create resumes Generate a one-page hiring-ready resume (HTML, PDF, and/or DOCX) tailored to a job - or a draft that may mark missing details with []. ## Overview `POST /v1/resumes` (MCP `create_resume`) builds a **one-page** résumé from optional `resume_text`, `profile`, and a target `job_id`. Hiring-ready output has **no placeholders** - unknowns are omitted, not invented. Requires `agent:tools`. Metered AI usage - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing). For cover letters see [Create cover letters](/jobs/api/create-cover-letters). ## When to use If you are building: * A **résumé tailor for a specific posting** * Pass `job_id` (or `job_context` from `get_job_keywords`) so bullets emphasize that role * An **apply pipeline that uploads a PDF** * Use default html+pdf, then send `pdf_base64` as `resume_file` on [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs) * A **profile-to-document product** * Feed structured `profile` plus existing `resume_text` and let the API layout one Letter page ## Basic usage ```bash curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/resumes" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "job_id": "YOUR_JOB_ID", "resume_text": "10 years frontend, React, design systems", "instructions": "Emphasize platform engineering" }' ``` MCP `create_resume` uses the same JSON body. Omit `formats` for default **html + pdf**. > **Tip:** Prefer `get_job_keywords` in `job_context` over pasting a full job description into `instructions`. ## Output formats This page is the canonical reference for document `formats` / `Accept` (cover letters use the same rules). | Request | Outputs | | --- | --- | | omit `formats` / `format` / document `Accept` | **html + pdf** | | `formats: ["html"]` or `format: "html"` or `Accept: text/html` | html only | | `format: "pdf"` or `Accept: application/pdf` | html + pdf | | `format: "docx"` or Word MIME `Accept` | html + docx | | `formats: ["html","pdf","docx"]` | all three (one AI charge) | Precedence: body `formats` > body `format` > `Accept` > default. Invalid body > `400`. `Accept` with only unknown types > `406`. Response is always a **JSON envelope** (not raw PDF bytes). PDF is US Letter, one page, shrink-to-fit (same pipeline as Worklittle consumer). DOCX is the same HTML with tight margins (no font auto-fit). Conversion is free - you only pay AI tokens. ## Create resumes reference > Résumé endpoints only. ### Overview | Method | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | POST | `/v1/resumes` | Hiring-ready one-page resume (default html + pdf; optional docx) | | POST | `/v1/draft-resumes` | Draft resume - may include `[]` when details are missing | Requires `agent:tools`. Metered AI tokens only - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing). MCP: `create_resume`, `create_draft_resume`. Cover letters: [Create cover letters](/jobs/api/create-cover-letters). Legacy: `POST /v1/agent/tool` with `{ "name": "create_resume", "args": { … } }`. ## Request body | Field | Type | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `job_id` | string | Target role; server loads posting context when set | | `resume_text` | string | Existing résumé plain text (primary content source) | | `profile` | object | Structured candidate fields (name, experience, education, …) | | `job_context` | object | Pre-fetched job fields / keywords | | `instructions` | string | Emphasis hints (e.g. highlight systems work) - not a paste of the full JD | | `formats` | string[] | Subset of `html`, `pdf`, `docx` | | `format` | string | Alias: `html` \| `pdf` \| `docx` | All fields optional. Hiring-ready mode **omits** unknown lines - it does not invent employers or leave placeholders. ## Response ```json { "document_type": "resume", "mode": "ready", "formats": ["html", "pdf"], "html": "

…

…", "pdf_base64": "JVBERi0xLjQK…", "pdf_mime": "application/pdf", "pdf_filename": "resume.pdf", "docx_base64": null, "docx_mime": null, "docx_filename": null, "billing": { } } ``` Attach `pdf_base64` on apply via `resume_file`, or render `html` in your own editor. ## Drafts `POST /v1/draft-resumes` / MCP `create_draft_resume` - when the profile is thin, the model may leave editable gaps like `[Company]` or `[Year]` instead of inventing history. Use hiring-ready `POST /v1/resumes` for applications. ```bash curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/draft-resumes" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "resume_text": "Junior engineer, some React" }' ``` Response includes `"mode": "draft"`. Same `formats` / `Accept` as above. ## Common mistakes | Wrong | Correct | | --- | --- | | Expecting `[Company]` on `create_resume` | Only drafts may use `[]` when input is incomplete | | Dumping the full JD into `instructions` | Use `get_job_keywords` > `job_context` | | Attaching the cover letter PDF as `resume_file` | Use `resume_file` for the résumé; cover letter fields are separate | | Missing `agent:tools` | Add the scope on the API key | ## Patterns and gotchas * **One page** - PDF auto-shrinks to fit Letter; keep content concise. * **Facts only** - hiring-ready never invents employers, schools, or metrics. * **Apply** - `resume_file.content_base64` on `submit_job_application`. * **Sibling API** - narrative letters are on [Create cover letters](/jobs/api/create-cover-letters).

Coding agent documentation index Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.worklittle.com/docs-agent-manifest.json Use this file to discover all available pages before exploring further. # Create cover letters Generate a one-page hiring-ready cover letter for a company and role (HTML, PDF, and/or DOCX) - or a draft that may mark missing details with []. ## Overview `POST /v1/cover-letters` (MCP `create_cover_letter`) writes a **short, employer-facing letter** - why this company and role, grounded in the candidate’s real background. Pass `company` and `role` (and/or `job_id`) so the letter is not generic. Hiring-ready output has **no placeholders**. Requires `agent:tools`. [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing). Résumés are a separate product: [Create resumes](/jobs/api/create-resumes). ## When to use If you are building: * A **per-company outreach or apply bundle** * Generate the letter after (or with) a tailored résumé, then attach via `cover_letter` or `cover_letter_file` on [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs) * An **agent that personalizes to one posting** * Set `job_id` plus `company` / `role` so the opening and body name the employer and title * A **tone-controlled writer** * Use `instructions` for voice (warm, concise, formal) without rewriting the résumé ## Basic usage ```bash curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/cover-letters" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "job_id": "abc123", "company": "Example Co", "role": "Senior Engineer", "resume_text": "…", "instructions": "Warm, concise tone" }' ``` MCP `create_cover_letter` uses the same JSON body. `company` and `role` are the fields that make this endpoint different from resume generation - set them when you know the target. > **Tip:** Pass the same `resume_text` / `profile` you used for the résumé so the letter stays consistent with the PDF you attach. ## Company, role, and job context | Goal | What to send | | --- | --- | | Named employer + title in the letter | `company` and `role` | | Pull posting context from Worklittle | `job_id` (server loads the job) | | Keywords without a full JD paste | `job_context` from `get_job_keywords` | | Background for “why me” paragraphs | `resume_text` and/or `profile` | Hiring-ready mode never invents experience. If you only pass `company` / `role` with almost no background, prefer a [draft](#drafts) or supply more profile data. ## Output formats Same `formats` / `format` / `Accept` rules as [Create resumes > Output formats](/jobs/api/create-resumes#output-formats). Default **html + pdf**. One AI charge regardless of how many formats you request. PDF is one Letter page; DOCX does not shrink-to-fit. ## Create cover letters reference > Cover letter endpoints only. ### Overview | Method | Path | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | POST | `/v1/cover-letters` | Hiring-ready one-page cover letter (default html + pdf; optional docx) | | POST | `/v1/draft-cover-letters` | Draft cover letter - may include `[]` when details are missing | Requires `agent:tools`. Metered AI tokens only - [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing). MCP: `create_cover_letter`, `create_draft_cover_letter`. Resumes: [Create resumes](/jobs/api/create-resumes). Legacy: `POST /v1/agent/tool` with `{ "name": "create_cover_letter", "args": { … } }`. ## Request body | Field | Type | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `job_id` | string | Loads posting context when provided | | `company` | string | Employer name (strongly recommended) | | `role` | string | Job title (strongly recommended) | | `resume_text` | string | Candidate background for the letter body | | `profile` | object | Structured profile JSON | | `job_context` | object | Pre-fetched job fields / keywords | | `instructions` | string | Tone or emphasis (not a full JD dump) | | `formats` | string[] | Subset of `html`, `pdf`, `docx` | | `format` | string | Alias: `html` \| `pdf` \| `docx` | ## Response ```json { "document_type": "cover_letter", "mode": "ready", "formats": ["html", "pdf"], "html": "

…

…", "pdf_base64": "JVBERi0xLjQK…", "pdf_mime": "application/pdf", "pdf_filename": "cover-letter.pdf", "docx_base64": null, "docx_mime": null, "docx_filename": null, "billing": { } } ``` On apply, use plain text/html in `cover_letter` or bytes in `cover_letter_file` - not the résumé `resume_file` field. ## Drafts `POST /v1/draft-cover-letters` / MCP `create_draft_cover_letter` - when background is thin, the model may leave gaps such as `[Company]` instead of inventing a story. Use hiring-ready `POST /v1/cover-letters` when sending to an employer. ```bash curl -s -X POST "https://api.worklittle.com/v1/draft-cover-letters" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "company": "Example Co", "role": "Engineer" }' ``` Response includes `"mode": "draft"`. ## Common mistakes | Wrong | Correct | | --- | --- | | Generic letter with no `company` / `role` / `job_id` | Set at least employer + title, or a `job_id` | | Expecting `[Company]` on hiring-ready | That only appears on drafts when input is incomplete | | Reusing résumé `instructions` as the letter body | `instructions` is tone/emphasis; content comes from profile + job | | Putting the letter PDF in `resume_file` | Use `cover_letter` or `cover_letter_file` | ## Patterns and gotchas * **Not a second résumé** - keep it short; sell fit for this employer/role. * **Match the résumé** - reuse the same `resume_text` / `profile` for consistency. * **Apply** - `cover_letter` (text) or `cover_letter_file` (base64) on `submit_job_application`. * **Formats detail** - see [Create resumes](/jobs/api/create-resumes#output-formats) so both pages stay in sync.

# Rate limits

Per-minute throttles and free monthly quotas for job search, boards, apply, and MCP job tools.

## API keys

Default **60 requests per minute** per key (1-minute KV window). Response: HTTP **429**, `error.code` = `RATE_LIMITED`, `Retry-After: 60`.

Implements exponential backoff in clients and agents that call `GET /jobs`, `GET /companies`, apply routes, and document tools.

## Free monthly quotas (UTC)

| Product | Endpoint or trigger | Free quota (UTC) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Job search** | `GET /jobs` / MCP `search_jobs` | **1000** jobs returned / month |
| **Job detail (raw / cached AI)** | `GET /jobs/:id` / MCP `get_job_details` | **Free** - raw `description_text` and already-cached AI never bill |
| **Job detail AI generation** | First-time AI enrichment only | **100** free generations/org/**day**, then token rates. Not a hard deny |
| **Job salary average** | `GET /jobs/salary-average` | **1000** requests / month |
| **Company map** | `GET /jobs/map` | **1000** requests / month |
| **Company search** | `GET /companies` | **1000** companies returned / month |

When a hard quota is exceeded, the API returns `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (HTTP 429). Inquire at [business@worklittle.com](mailto:business@worklittle.com) for higher limits.

## Public job boards

| Route | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Board profile, list, detail | 120/min per IP |
| Apply, parse-resume | 20/min per IP |
| Sitemap | 30/min per IP |

## MCP job tools

MCP forwards Jobs API rate limits for tools like `search_jobs`, `get_job_details`, and apply helpers. A 429 from api.worklittle.com surfaces as a JSON-RPC error on the MCP client. Retry after backoff.

# Errors

Structured JSON errors for job search, boards, apply, and MCP job tools.

## REST error shape

Failed REST calls return JSON like:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "UNAUTHORIZED",
    "message": "Invalid or missing API key",
    "documentation_url": "https://docs.worklittle.com/help/api/api-key-not-working"
  }
}
```

`documentation_url` is present on `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `WORK_EMAIL_REQUIRED`, `PAYMENT_REQUIRED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, and `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. Fetch that page instead of guessing scopes or billing next steps. Other codes omit the field.

Log the response body when debugging search, apply, or document generation on [**Usage**](https://worklittle.com/business/usage).

## HTTP status codes

| HTTP | code | Common Jobs causes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | Invalid query filters or apply payload |
| 401 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid API key |
| 402 | `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | AI token usage without a valid billing card / limit |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Scope missing (`jobs:read`, `jobs:apply`, `agent:tools`) |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Unknown job or company id |
| 410 | `GONE` | Public People Search is temporarily disabled |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` / `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | Per-key throttle or free monthly quota |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Upstream failure |

## MCP JSON-RPC codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| -32700 | Parse error |
| -32600 | Invalid request (often auth) |
| -32601 | Method or tool not found |
| -32602 | Invalid params |
| -32603 | Internal error (may wrap upstream 429/5xx) |

# FAQ

Short answers about job search, public boards, apply, and document tools.

## Do I need separate keys for MCP and REST?

No. One `sk-wl-api01-...` key works for both `api.worklittle.com` and `mcp.worklittle.com`. Create and revoke keys only in the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys).

## REST or MCP: which should I use?

Same account, scopes, and billing. Use **REST** for server-side job search and fixed HTTP contracts. Use **MCP** when wiring Worklittle into Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or other MCP clients. Start with the [MCP guide](/jobs/mcp).

## What is the difference between GET /jobs and /job-boards/:company/jobs?

`GET /jobs` searches Worklittle's market-wide job index. `/job-boards/:company/jobs` lists only jobs **that employer published on Worklittle**. Use the index for discovery; use job boards for a white-label career site.

## Can I submit applications for every job in search results?

No. Apply endpoints work only for **Worklittle-hosted** jobs. Other indexed roles may include an employer `apply_url` instead. See [Apply for jobs](/jobs/api/apply-for-jobs).

## What API key scopes do I need for Jobs?

| Goal | Scopes |
| --- | --- |
| Search and read jobs | `jobs:read` |
| Submit applications | `jobs:apply` |
| Résumés and cover letters | `agent:tools` |

Create keys on [**API keys**](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys).

## What is free with an API key?

Job search, boards, hosted apply, and most read helpers are free within monthly quotas on [Rate limits](/jobs/resources/rate-limits). The only paid meter is **AI tokens** (document tools, Apply with AI model turns, first-time AI job-description generation after the free daily allowance). See [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).

## What happens when my balance runs out?

Token-billed routes return HTTP **402** (`PAYMENT_REQUIRED`). Update your card or monthly limit on [**Billing**](https://worklittle.com/business/billing). Free quota endpoints keep working.

## How are résumés and cover letters billed?

Document generation bills **AI tokens** only. See [Pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing) and [**Usage**](https://worklittle.com/business/usage).

## What rate limits apply?

API keys default to **60 requests per minute**. Public job boards allow **120/min** for list and detail and **20/min** for apply. Free monthly quotas are on [Rate limits](/jobs/resources/rate-limits).

# Overview

Business API for posting jobs, managing candidates and employees, surveys, documents, attendance, and webhooks in Worklittle.

The same org data your teammates see in Worklittle Business is writable from REST, SDK, CLI, and MCP. Automate hiring without leaving Worklittle as the source of truth.

## What Business docs cover

Use these docs when you are **hiring and running HR in Worklittle** - posting roles, running an ATS, managing employees, or syncing events out via webhooks.

Typical Business integrations:

1. **Post and manage jobs** - `/jobs/post` and `/job-listings` so openings appear on your Worklittle board and in search.
2. **ATS and candidates** - List, stage, note, and interview candidates. Updates show instantly in the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business).
3. **Organization** - Company profile, members, and employer settings.
4. **HR tools** - Surveys, documents / e-sign, and attendance.
5. **Webhooks** - `candidate.application_submitted`, `candidate.stage_changed`, and related events for an external HRIS.

For market-wide job search, public boards for other employers, Apply with AI, or résumé generation as a product, switch to [Jobs docs](/jobs/get-started/overview).

## Base URLs

| Surface | Base URL |
| --- | --- |
| REST Business / ATS API | `https://api.worklittle.com` |
| MCP | `https://mcp.worklittle.com` (POST `/`) |
| Your public board | `https://api.worklittle.com/job-boards/:company/jobs` |
| Worklittle Business UI | [https://worklittle.com/business](https://worklittle.com/business) |

Many ATS and posting routes are **free with an API key**. Platform AI and a few metered tools are on [Pricing](/business/get-started/pricing).

## Authentication

Automations use a **Bearer API key** with employer scopes such as `jobs:post`, `jobs:applications`, and `webhooks:manage`:

```http
Authorization: Bearer sk-wl-api01-...
```

Create keys under [**API keys**](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys). Details: [API Keys](/business/get-started/api-keys).

The signed-in Worklittle Business UI uses your **session** for the same org data. Teammates who never touch the API still see script and MCP updates in the product.

# API Keys

API keys for posting, ATS, organization, documents, and webhooks. Create and revoke them in Worklittle Business.

## Create a key

In the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business), go to [**API keys**](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys) and select **Create API key**. Name the key for your environment (for example "Production backend"). The response shows the full `sk-wl-api01-...` secret **once**.

Store it in a secrets manager or environment variable. Worklittle never shows the full secret again, only a prefix for identification.

## Revoke a key

On the same [**API keys**](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys) page, open the menu on a row and choose **Revoke**. The key stops working immediately. This cannot be undone.

To rotate, create a new key, deploy the new secret, then revoke the old key.

## Key format and scopes

Keys use the `sk-wl-api01-` prefix. Default rate limit is **60 requests per minute** per key. View per-key limits on [**Limits**](https://worklittle.com/business/limits) in Worklittle Business.

| Scope | Allows |
| --- | --- |
| `jobs:post` | `/job-listings`, `/jobs/manage`, `/jobs/post/*` (employer listings) |
| `jobs:applications` | ATS routes (`/candidates`, `/employees`, `/offers`, `/attendance`, email, etc.) |
| `people:read` | Reserved - public People Search is temporarily unavailable |
| `webhooks:manage` | `/webhooks` CRUD and delivery |
| `documents:read` / `documents:write` | `/platform/documents` HR docs and e-sign |
| `employees:read` | Survey management and related employee-org reads |

New keys receive the default scopes for your account. Agents in Worklittle Business can also call `list_api_keys` and `revoke_api_key` when you approve those actions.

## Session routes (Worklittle Business backend)

When you are signed in, the Worklittle Business calls these routes on `api.worklittle.com` with your session (not your `sk-wl-api01-...` secret):

| Method | Path | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api-keys` | List your keys |
| POST | `/api-keys` | Create a key |
| DELETE | `/api-keys/:id` | Revoke a key |

# Pricing

Business Platform bills AI tokens only. Free compute and email quotas are on Rate limits. Job listings and most ATS routes stay free.

Our platform uses a frontier model with intelligent agentic capabilities. You can view full logs of API calls and token cost in [Usage](https://worklittle.com/business/usage).

Business Platform AI includes $0.10 of free monthly AI credit per company organization. After that, tokens are pay as you go. ATS, posting, emails, and most compute quotas are free within monthly limits on Rate limits. Add a card on Billing for AI usage beyond free credit. We charge at the end of each UTC month for accrued usage (if at least $0.50), and earlier when amount owed reaches $20.

## AI tokens

| What bills | When | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **AI tokens** | Platform agent chat, `web_search` grounding, `bulk_ai` custom columns, and other model-backed Work tools | **$2.50** per 1M input tokens and **$15.00** per 1M output tokens |

Job listings, most ATS routes, structured/sandbox custom columns, sandbox Python, and platform email do **not** bill tokens - they use free monthly quotas on [Rate limits](/business/resources/rate-limits).

## Free with an API key

| Area | Examples | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Job listings** | Publish / renew active posts | Free |
| **Hosted apply** | `POST /jobs/:id/apply`, MCP `submit_job_application` | **$0.01** per successful submit |
| **Native tabular exports** | `run_python_jobs` with `native_format` (pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/csv) | Free |
| **Manage candidates (ATS)** | `/candidates`, notes, interviews, import, bookmarks, pipeline alerts | `jobs:applications` |
| **Employees** | `/employees`, employment periods, performance feedback | `jobs:applications` |
| **Offers & templates** | `/offers`, `/email-messages` CRUD and preview | `jobs:applications` |
| **Post jobs** | `/job-listings`, `/jobs/manage` | `jobs:post` |
| **Organization** | `/company-organizations`, `/interview-questions` | `jobs:applications` |
| **Webhooks** | `/webhooks` CRUD and delivery | `webhooks:manage` |
| **Market stats** | `GET /stats`, MCP `get_market_overview` | `jobs:read` |
| **MCP ATS tools** | `list_candidates`, `update_candidates`, `create_webhook`, etc. | Same as free REST above |
| **Document formats** | HTML / PDF / DOCX on document responses | Included; only AI tokens bill |
| **Failed calls** | Unsuccessful or errored requests | **Free** - tokens already used still bill |
| **Job alerts** | Consumer Settings profile sync only (no public job-alerts API) | Free up to **100** emails/user/UTC month |

## Free quotas and rate limits

Custom-column row quotas, sandbox Python, platform email, and the **60 requests/minute** key limit live on [Rate limits](/business/resources/rate-limits).

## Looking for Jobs API pricing?

Jobs search, Apply with AI session meters, and document tools live under [Jobs pricing](/jobs/get-started/pricing).

# SDK

TypeScript and Python clients for api.worklittle.com. Same key, same resources. Language tabs below.

## Install

```bash
npm install worklittle
export WORKLITTLE_API_KEY="sk-wl-api01-..."
```

Import as `worklittle`. To work from the monorepo instead: `cd packages/sdk-js && npm install && npm run build`.

## Authentication

Bearer token. Create a key in the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business) under [API keys](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys).

```http
Authorization: Bearer sk-wl-api01-...
```

For the SDK and CLI, set `WORKLITTLE_API_KEY`. Prefer the env var over `--api-key` so the key does not appear in process lists. Do not point `--base-url` at hosts you do not trust. Public board GETs and public survey submit do not require a key.

## Quickstart

```ts
import { createWorklittle } from "worklittle";

const wl = createWorklittle(); // reads WORKLITTLE_API_KEY
const page = await wl.jobs.search({ q: "software engineer", limit: 3 });
```

Filters match `GET /jobs`. Title exclusions use a leading dash in `title` / `q` (`-Senior`). Employer exclusions use the same pattern on `company` (`-lucid-motors`):

```ts
await wl.jobs.search({
  title: "software engineer, -senior",
  company: "-lucid-motors,-tesla",
  limit: 10,
});
```

Equivalent HTTP:

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/jobs?q=software+engineer&limit=3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

## Search > detail

```ts
const page = await wl.jobs.search({ q: "software engineer", limit: 3 });
const rows = (page as { data?: Array<{ job_id?: string; id?: string }> }).data ?? [];
const id = rows[0]?.job_id || rows[0]?.id;
const detail = await wl.jobs.get(String(id));
```

**Response** (`GET /jobs`):

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "job_id": "…",
      "title": "Software Engineer",
      "company_name": "Example Co",
      "location": "Remote"
    }
  ],
  "meta": { "next_cursor": "…" }
}
```

List rows are snippets. Use `GET /jobs/:id` for the full posting. See [Search jobs](/business/api/search-jobs).

## Board > apply

`YOUR_ORG_SLUG` is the employer board slug (same as careers URLs).

```ts
import { createWorklittle, jobCareersPath } from "worklittle";

const wl = createWorklittle();
const company = "YOUR_ORG_SLUG";
const board = (await wl.boards.get(company)) as {
  jobs: Array<{ id: string; slug?: string }>;
};
const jobRef = board.jobs[0]!.slug || board.jobs[0]!.id;
const job = await wl.boards.getJob(company, jobRef);
// job.application_fields = form schema
await wl.boards.submitApplication(company, job as never, {
  name: "Alex Rivera",
  email: "alex@example.com",
});
jobCareersPath(board.jobs[0]!); // /careers/{slug}
```

See [Apply for jobs](/business/api/apply-for-jobs).

## Candidates > profile

Requires a key with `jobs:applications` for your org.

```ts
const listed = await wl.candidates.list({ limit: 10 });
const detail = await wl.candidates.get("CANDIDATE_ID");
```

```bash
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/candidates?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
curl -s "https://api.worklittle.com/candidates/CANDIDATE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLITTLE_API_KEY"
```

See [Manage candidates](/business/api/manage-candidates).

## Resources

| Method | HTTP | Docs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `wl.jobs.search` / `get` | `GET /jobs`, `GET /jobs/:id` | [Search jobs](/business/api/search-jobs) |
| `wl.companies.search` | `GET /companies` | [Search companies](/business/api/search-companies) |
| `wl.boards.get` / `getJob` / `apply` | `/job-boards/:company/…` | [Apply for jobs](/business/api/apply-for-jobs) |
| `wl.apply.submit` | `POST /jobs/:id/apply` | [Apply for jobs](/business/api/apply-for-jobs) |
| `wl.apply.startWithAi` / `getWithAiSession` / `continueWithAi` / `approveWithAiSubmit` / `stopWithAi` | `/v1/apply-with-ai` | [Apply for jobs](/business/api/apply-for-jobs) |
| `wl.candidates.list` / `get` | `GET /candidates`, `GET /candidates/:id` | [Manage candidates](/business/api/manage-candidates) |
| `wl.employees.*` | `/employees` | [Manage organization](/business/api/manage-organization) |
| `wl.jobListings.*` / `wl.employerJobs.*` | `/job-listings`, `/jobs/post` | [Post a job](/business/api/post-a-job) |
| `wl.surveys.*` | `/platform/surveys` | [Surveys](/business/api/surveys) |
| `wl.documents.*` | `/platform/documents` | [Documents](/business/api/documents) |
| `wl.attendance.*` | `/attendance` | [Attendance](/business/api/attendance) |
| `wl.webhooks.*` | `/webhooks` | [Webhooks](/business/webhooks/integration) |
| `wl.resumes.*` / `wl.coverLetters.*` | `POST /v1/resumes`, `POST /v1/cover-letters` | [Create resumes](/business/api/create-resumes) |

## Webhooks

```ts
import { verifyWebhookSignature } from "worklittle";

const ok = verifyWebhookSignature({
  signatureHeader: req.headers["worklittle-webhook-signature"] as string,
  timestamp: req.headers["worklittle-webhook-timestamp"] as string,
  rawBody,
  secret: process.env.WORKLITTLE_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
});
```

See [Webhook integration](/business/webhooks/integration).

## Errors

Throws `WorklittleError` with `status`, `code`, `message`, and `requestId` when present.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| **429** | Rate limited; client retries using `Retry-After` |
| **402** | Payment required (failed card or monthly limit) - do not retry |
| **401 / 403** | Invalid key or missing scope |

# CLI

worklittle command-line client. JSON on stdout by default.

## Install

**Homebrew** (recommended)

```bash
brew install worklittle/tap/worklittle
```

Tap: [`worklittle/homebrew-tap`](https://github.com/worklittle/homebrew-tap). Homebrew installs Node 18+ as a dependency.

**curl** (macOS / Linux, needs Node 18+)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://worklittle.com/install | bash
```

Same script: `https://docs.worklittle.com/install`. Verifies the CLI checksum from `manifest.json` before install. Default path is `~/.local/bin/worklittle` (override with `WORKLITTLE_INSTALL_PREFIX`).

**From the monorepo**

```bash
cd packages/sdk-js && npm install && npm run build
node dist/cli.js help
# or: npm link
```

Published packages:

```bash
npm install worklittle
pip install worklittle
```

The TypeScript package is also on npm as `@worklittle/sdk` (same code). The CLI binary is `worklittle` (`npm install -g worklittle`). Homebrew remains the recommended CLI install.

## Authentication

Bearer token. Create a key in the [Worklittle Business](https://worklittle.com/business) under [API keys](https://worklittle.com/business/api-keys).

```http
Authorization: Bearer sk-wl-api01-...
```

For the SDK and CLI, set `WORKLITTLE_API_KEY`. Prefer the env var over `--api-key` so the key does not appear in process lists. Do not point `--base-url` at hosts you do not trust. Public board GETs and public survey submit do not require a key.

## Usage

```text
worklittle <group> <action> [args] [--flag value] [--body '{}'] [--pretty|--json] [--api-key KEY]
```

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--pretty` | Indented JSON on stdout |
| `--json` | Compact JSON (default) |
| `--api-key` | Override `WORKLITTLE_API_KEY` |
| `--base-url` | Override `https://api.worklittle.com` |
| `--body` | JSON body for POST/PATCH |
| `--q` `--title` `--limit` `--cursor` `--id` `--company` | Query params / positional fallbacks (same names as `GET /jobs`) |

`--company` accepts bare slugs (include OR) or leading-dash slugs to exclude, e.g. `--company=-lucid-motors,-tesla`. Title negatives stay in `--q` / `--title` (`-Senior`). Other `GET /jobs` flags pass through by name (`--workplace_type`, `--posted_within_days`, `--near_lat`, …). Full filter reference: [Search jobs](/business/api/search-jobs).

Also: `jobs map`, `jobs salary-average`, `companies search`, `stats get` (JS and Python CLIs).

Exit **0** on success, **2** on 401/403, **1** on other failures. Errors are JSON on stderr.

## Example

```bash
worklittle jobs search --q="software engineer" --limit 1 --pretty
worklittle jobs search --title="software engineer, -senior" --company="-lucid-motors,-tesla" --limit 5 --pretty
```

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "job_id": "…",
      "title": "Software Engineer",
      "company_name": "Example Co",
      "location": "San Francisco, CA"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "limit": 1,
    "next_cursor": "…"
  }
}
```

Then:

```bash
worklittle jobs get JOB_ID --pretty
```

## Board > apply

```bash
worklittle boards get YOUR_ORG_SLUG --include facets --pretty
worklittle boards job YOUR_ORG_SLUG JOB_SLUG_OR_ID --pretty
worklittle boards apply YOUR_ORG_SLUG JOB_SLUG_OR_ID --body '{
  "name": "Alex Rivera",
  "email": "alex@example.com",
  "answers": {}
}'
```

See [Apply for jobs](/business/api/apply-for-jobs).

## Candidates

```bash
worklittle candidates list --limit 10 --pretty
worklittle candidates get CANDIDATE_ID --pretty
```

See [Manage candidates](/business/api/manage-candidates).

## Commands

| Command | Args / flags | HTTP |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jobs search` | `--q` `--title` `--company` (+ any `GET /jobs` flag) | `GET /jobs` |
| `jobs get` | `JOB_ID` | `GET /jobs/:id` |
| `jobs map` | query flags | `GET /jobs/map` |
| `jobs salary-average` | query flags | `GET /jobs/salary-average` |
| `companies search` | query flags | `GET /companies` |

| `boards get` | `COMPANY` [`--include facets`] | `GET /job-boards/:company/board` |
| `boards jobs` | `COMPANY` | `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs` |
| `boards job` | `COMPANY` `ID_OR_SLUG` | `GET /job-boards/:company/jobs/:id` |
| `boards facets` | `COMPANY` | `GET /job-boards/:company/facets` |
| `boards apply` | `COMPANY` `ID_OR_SLUG` `--body` | `POST …/jobs/:id/apply` |
| `apply submit` | `JOB_ID` `--body` | `POST /jobs/:id/apply` |
| `apply-with-ai *` | id / `--body` | `/v1/apply-with-ai` |
| `applied list` / `counts` / `track` / `update` | id / `--body` | `/applied-jobs` |
| `candidates list` / `get` / `update` / `import` / `stages` | id / `--body` | `/candidates`, `/pipeline-stages` |
| `employees list` / `get` / `create` / `update` / `delete` | id / `--body` | `/employees` |
| `listings *` | id / `--body` | `/job-listings` |
| `employer-jobs *` | id / `--body` | `/jobs/post` |

| `webhooks list` / `create` / `get` / `update` / `delete` / `test` / `rotate-secret` / `deliveries` | id / `--body` | `/webhooks` |
